issue.title: Lack of wording to specify that the destruction of an atomic object is not an atomic operation

discussion.p: Since neither `#1` happens-before nor happens-after `#2`, and `#1` is an atomic operation, whether this program contains a data race depends on whether `#2` is a non-atomic operation due to p17:

blockquote.p: at least one of which is not an atomic operation
Effects: Initializes the atomic object with the value of `T()`. Initialization is not an atomic operation ().

discussion.p: However, it lacks the wording to explicitly state that the destruction of an atomic object is not an atomic operation.
